beliefs: For x >= -8, f(x) = 8 - 9.6x exactly (linear, slope -9.6) [E1, E2]
For x <= -16, f(x) is nearly constant around 8 with tiny variation (7.86 to 8.13) [E1, E2]
Between x=-16 and x=-8 there is a transition: at x=-9 and x=-8.5 the steep line still holds (94.4, 89.6), but at x=-10 and above (toward -16) values drop to ~8 [E2]
The steep branch 8-9.6x ends somewhere between x=-10 and x=-9 (at -10 y≈8.2, at -9 y=94.4) [E2]
Values in the near-constant region fluctuate slightly (8.0-8.27), possibly noise around 8 [E1, E2]
notes: E2 shows the steep linear branch extends only down to about x=-9; at x=-10 and below values are ~8. So the breakpoint is between -10 and -9, not -16. The constant region is roughly 8 with small noise.
